signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Use the same account as in the QuaDev mobile app.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.subtitle: One account for the web and the QuaDev mobile app.
signUp.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with upper and lower case letters, a number and a special character.

forgotPassword.title: Reset password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Please, enter your email address. We will send you a link to create a new password.
forgotPassword.success:
If an account exists for that email, we've sent it a link to reset the password.

Open the link to choose a new password, then sign in.
forgotPassword.error: There was an error sending the password reset email

emailVerification.title: Welcome to
emailVerification.emailSent: We've sent a verification email to {{email}}.
emailVerification.emailVerificationInstructions: Open the link in the email, then come back and press "I've verified my email".
emailVerification.notVerifiedYet: Your email isn't verified yet. Open the link in the email, then try again.

completeProfile.title: Complete your profile
completeProfile.subtitle: Tell us your name to finish setting up your account. Your date of birth is optional.

deleteAccount.title: Are you sure?
deleteAccount.description: We’re sorry to see you go. Deleting your account will permanently erase all your data, and you will lose access to the app. However, you’re always welcome to create a new account if you decide to return.
deleteAccount.reauthDescription: For your security, enter your password to confirm that you want to delete your account.
deleteAccount.googleWindowNotice: Continue in the Google window that opened.
deleteAccount.successMessage: Your account has been successfully deleted.
deleteAccount.unavailableOnWeb: This account signs in with Apple, which the website does not support yet. To delete it, use the QuaDev mobile app, or write to us from the account's email address.

home.welcomeDescription: Your account is ready. New tools will show up here as they are released.
home.mockInterviewDescription: Practise with an AI interviewer that asks the questions and follows up on your answers.
home.liveInterviewDescription: Short bullet points for each question while you are being interviewed, with a review afterwards.
home.cvToolDescription: Improve your CV and create versions tailored to each job.

access.notAvailableChip: Not available for your account yet
access.stagesDescription: We are opening this tool to accounts in stages. You don’t need to do anything.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: What you have done, read once and reused for every job.
profile.notAvailableDescription: Add your CV and other documents once. We read them and build your skill map: skills, experience, projects, achievements and stories.
profile.loadErrorMessage: We couldn’t load your profile. Check your connection and try again.
profile.emptyDescription: Add your CV and anything else that shows your experience: documents, notes, links. We read each one once and build your skill map.
profile.fullMessage: Your profile has {{max}} resources, the most it can hold. Remove one to add another.
profile.dailyLimitMessage: You’ve reached today’s limit of {{max}} resources. You can add more after {{time}}.

addResource.choiceDescription: Each resource is read once. You can remove it at any time.
addResource.cvChoiceDescription: It is added to your profile as a CV and read once.
addResource.fileOptionDescription: PDF, Word (.docx) or text, up to 10 MB
addResource.textOptionDescription: Notes, stories, a CV as text. Up to 50,000 characters
addResource.linkOptionDescription: The https address of a public page. Read once
addResource.fileEmptyText: PDF, Word (.docx) or text, up to 10 MB
addResource.titleFromFileHint: Taken from the file name. Change it if you like.
addResource.addressHint: The page must be public. We read it once. For LinkedIn, save your profile as a PDF and upload the file.
addResource.fileTypeError: This file can’t be read. Choose a PDF, a Word document (.docx) or a text file.
addResource.fileSizeError: This file is {{size}}. The limit is 10 MB.
addResource.textLengthError: This is longer than 50,000 characters. Shorten it or split it into two resources.
addResource.addressRequiredError: Enter the https address of a public page.
addResource.addressError: Enter the https address of a public page. Pages on a private network can’t be read.
addResource.failedMessage: We couldn’t add this. Check your connection and try again.
addResource.uploadFailedMessage: The file didn’t upload. Check your connection and try again.
addResource.uploadRefusedMessage: This file was not accepted. It must be a PDF, a Word document (.docx) or a text file of up to 10 MB.
addResource.notAvailableMessage: This tool is not available for your account yet.

resource.notFoundTitle: This resource is not in your profile
resource.readingDescription: This usually takes a few seconds. You can leave this screen: the items will appear in your skill map when it is done.
resource.stuckTitle: This is taking longer than usual
resource.stuckUploadDescription: The upload may not have finished. A resource is read once, so remove it and add it again.
resource.stuckReadingDescription: Reading it did not finish. A resource is read once, so remove it and add it again.
resource.nothingNewDescription: Your profile already has what this says, so no item was added twice.
resource.failedUnsupportedFileDescription: It must be a PDF, a Word document (.docx) or a text file, without a password. A resource is read once: remove this one and add it again.
resource.failedEmptyTitle: We found no text to read in this
resource.failedEmptyDescription: A scanned page saved as a picture has no text. A resource is read once: remove this one and add another.
resource.failedTooLongDescription: It is longer than 50,000 characters. Remove it and split it into two resources.
resource.failedTooLargeDescription: It is larger than 10 MB. Remove it and add a smaller file.
resource.failedLinkUnreadableDescription: It may be private or need a sign-in. For LinkedIn, save your profile as a PDF and add the file. A resource is read once: remove this one and add it again.
resource.failedQuotaDescription: You’ve reached today’s limit of {{max}} resources, so this one was not read. Remove it and add it again after {{time}}.
resource.failedBlockedDescription: A resource is read once: remove this one.
resource.failedModelTitle: Reading this didn’t work this time
resource.failedModelDescription: Remove it and add it again.
resource.failedInternalTitle: Something went wrong on our side
resource.failedInternalDescription: Remove it and add it again.
resource.failedFlagOffTitle: This tool is not available for your account yet
resource.failedFlagOffDescription: So this one was not read. You can remove it.
resource.removeDialogItems_one: This also removes the {{count}} item that came from it.
resource.removeDialogItems_other: This also removes the {{count}} items that came from it.
resource.removeDialogItemsEdited_one: This also removes the {{count}} item that came from it, including {{edited}} you edited.
resource.removeDialogItemsEdited_other: This also removes the {{count}} items that came from it, including {{edited}} you edited.
resource.removeDialogBriefs_one: Briefs that used it will show as out of date.
resource.removeDialogBriefs_other: Briefs that used them will show as out of date.
resource.removeDialogNoItems: It has no items in your skill map.
resource.removeFailedMessage: We couldn’t remove this. Check your connection and try again.

skillMap.title: Skill map
skillMap.emptyDescription: Add your CV to your profile. The skills, experience, projects, achievements and stories in it will be listed here, each with the passage it came from.
skillMap.readingDescription: The items will appear here as soon as it has been read. This usually takes a few seconds.
skillMap.hiddenCount_one: {{count}} hidden item · never used in briefs, key points or CVs
skillMap.hiddenCount_other: {{count}} hidden items · never used in briefs, key points or CVs
skillMap.noResultSearchDescription: Nothing in your skill map matches “{{query}}” with these filters.
skillMap.noResultDescription: Nothing in your skill map matches these filters.

item.notFoundTitle: This item is not in your skill map
item.saveFailedMessage: We couldn’t save your change. Try again.
item.starDescription: Starred items come first in briefs and key points
item.hideDescription: Hidden items are never sent to the model
item.evidenceNote: This passage is what was read. It can’t be changed.
item.removeDialogDescription: It will no longer be used in briefs, key points or CVs. The resource it came from stays in your profile.
item.removeFailedMessage: We couldn’t remove this. Check your connection and try again.

publicHome.title: Building robust software solutions
publicHome.description: One QuaDev account for the web and the mobile app. New tools will arrive here as they are released.
publicHome.descriptionWithAccount: One QuaDev account for the web and the mobile app. Create it today; new tools will arrive here as they are released.
publicHome.signUpCardDescription: Use your email, Google or Apple. The same account works in the mobile app.
publicHome.dataCardDescription: Your name and email are enough. Your date of birth is optional.
publicHome.deleteCardDescription: You can delete your account and all its data at any time.

deleteAccountInfo.title: Delete your account
deleteAccountInfo.description: You can delete your QuaDev account at any time. Deleting it is permanent.
deleteAccountInfo.stepConfirm: Confirm. You may be asked for your password again.
deleteAccountInfo.erasedDescription: Your account and its profile: your name, your email, your date of birth if you gave it, and the data linked to your account.
deleteAccountInfo.permanentDescription: A deleted account cannot be restored. You can create a new account later.
deleteAccountInfo.emailDescription: If you cannot use the app, send an email from the address of your account to the address below and ask us to delete it.

notFound.description: This page does not exist or has moved.
